watchlist_definition: degree-ranked candidate-network drugs; fixed before patient-data analysis

MIMIC_IV_demo_v2_2.role: secondary inpatient prescription-order transport/sensitivity analysis; intentionally small public demo

ONC_patient_realization.interpretation: Global ONC realization rates differ strongly, but the watchlist-specific ONC contrast among realized pairs is underpowered/non-significant and is not claimed as replicated.

interpretation: The primary patient-transport test uses all observed pairs whose drugs are rankable in the candidate network, without conditioning on candidate-edge membership. Candidate-edge coverage is secondary operational reach because the top-decile watchlist already covers 65.0% of all candidate-network edges before cohort data are introduced. Neither analysis establishes confirmed interaction status, clinical severity, patient-specific risk, fired alerts, or clinical outcomes.
